map.因为短文本信息量不足：GBK 与 Big5 的字节区间大面积重叠，纯 ASCII: Because short text carries too little information: the byte ranges of GBK and Big5 overlap extensively, pure ASCII content is valid under almost any encoding, and UTF-8 and Latin-1 have no BOM to distinguish. The tool can only give the most probable guess; the reliable approach is combining language priors (Chinese suggesting GBK/UTF-8) with the business source, or asking the data provider to declare the encoding.
